changes.to: PL-Universe product page (checked 2026-11-17): height adjustable 165-195 cm (recorded at the top), 300 kg, 7-DoF arms with 954 mm span and about 7 kg per arm, four-wheel omnidirectional base at more than 2.5 m/s, at least 8 h on a 48 V 50 Ah pack (2,400 Wh computed as V x Ah) with 2 h charging, plus or minus 0.05 mm repeatability. Total DoF is not published for the body. The newer ProWhite Robot 2.0 is a different, heavier 400 kg configuration with 2,035 mm height and 6-DoF arms.

PL-Universe's industrial wheeled humanoid ProWhite: 7-DoF arms carrying about 7 kg each on a four-wheel omnidirectional base, height adjustable 165-195 cm, 300 kg, 8 h and plus or minus 0.05 mm repeatability.
